title: Cad Play Per Model Interactions
description: Wire interaction sessions and window engagement for every spatial play quad pane (shape, building, energy, structure-classic), not only shape.
summary: Fixed CAD play infinite React update loop when starting interactions (e.g. Box). Root cause: every InteractionRepl engagement snapshot called setPaneEngagement with a freshly mirrored WindowEngagement object, which always failed reference equality and rebuilt all window kinds + emitted, retriggering engagement sync in a cycle. Added windowEngagementDigest/windowEngagementsEqual for content-based dedup, in-place engagement updates on existing WindowKindRuntime instances with a shallow-copied windowKinds array for golden refresh, and tests. All cad/js/renderer vitest (50) pass.
